summary: First iteration testing (Phase 1-3) of Sistem Informasi Pabrik Es Kristal. Built pytest regression suite covering auth (8 roles + brute-force lockout), master data (catalog/settings/customers/users/audit), production (create/approve/reject/anomaly + RBAC), orders/surat jalan (create, reorder, ESC/P .prn, handover FIFO deduct, oversell rejection, edit-after-handover blocked, revise, cancel with reason), and reports (dashboard/series/xlsx export). All 28 backend tests PASS (100%). Frontend smoke-tested with Playwright across 3 roles (marketing, produksi, admin): login works, RBAC nav filtering works for produksi (no Surat Jalan), harvest input + confirmation modal + toast works, admin sees full menu, wrong password stays on login. Console clean except expected 401 on invalid login.

minor.issue: Anomaly flag depends on machines.avg_sacks_per_harvest > 0; on fresh seed the average is 0 so 300-sak entries do NOT get anomaly=true. Consider using rolling average of recent harvests or a fallback threshold (e.g. > 100 sacks/harvest) so anomaly badge works from day one.

Uses updateOne with sort option which MongoDB rejects for updateOne; the reason field silently fails to attach to the last stock_move (wrapped in .catch(() => {})). Should use collection.findOneAndUpdate with sort, or update by _id captured from addBatch/consumeFifo return value.

Lock identifier is req.ip:username. Behind FastAPI proxy req.ip may resolve to 127.0.0.1 for every request (no trust proxy set in Express), so all users share a single IP bucket — DoS risk. Enable app.set('trust proxy', true) and/or key lockout by username only.

issues: Marketing sees 'Produksi' and 'Master Data' nav items. The input form is correctly hidden (canInput role check), so it acts as read-only view — but per requirement 'Marketing tidak melihat form panen' this is acceptable. If stricter menu-hiding is desired, remove 'marketing' from NAV.produksi roles in /app/frontend/public/js/app.js line 5.
After a failed login the password field is not cleared and no inline error message is shown near the form — only a toast; consider a persistent error hint under the password input.

action_items: (Minor) Improve anomaly detection to work on cold-start when machine.avg_sacks_per_harvest = 0.
(Minor) Fix stock adjust reason persistence (updateOne with sort is unsupported in MongoDB).
(Security) Set Express 'trust proxy' so login-attempts key uses real client IP.
(Optional UX) Decide whether Marketing role should see 'Produksi'/'Master Data' menu items — code intentionally includes them for read-only viewing.
critical_code_review_comments: orders.js /:id/revise copies o with spread including _id then overrides — OK, but 'revision_of' is set on the NEW doc; original SJ is marked status:'revised'. Downstream reports filter revised out of demand — good.

orders.js handover: consumeFifo is executed BEFORE the order status update. If consumeFifo throws mid-loop (e.g. second item lacks stock while first already deducted), stock is left partially consumed with no rollback. Consider a pre-check total availability before consuming, or wrap in a MongoDB transaction.
auth.js login: password_hash verified with verifyPassword; brute force counter is not decremented after successful login for other keys — fine, but confirm bcrypt hash format ($2b$) via seeding.

master.js PUT /settings: any authenticated 'management' role can update settings but requirement said management is read-only. Currently requireRole('management') allows master_admin (bypass) AND management to update settings. Consider tightening to master_admin only, or explicitly document that management is allowed to change daily_target_ton.
master.js GET /users: allowed for management/co_driver/marketing but returns full user list including inactive users; consider filtering active:true for non-admins.
reports.js /export: no date validation — very large ranges could OOM. Add max-range guard (e.g. 366 days).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login, RBAC nav, harvest input+confirm+toast, admin master data page)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed customers, harvests, and SJs (SJ/YYYYMM/NNNN). One test also creates a user 'test_<hex>' with role=driver via admin — recommend cleanup job if suite is re-run frequently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend 100% green. Focus remaining UI regression on: (1) Prioritas Queue drag & drop persists order and label updates, (2) Print SJ modal WYSIWYG + .prn download button both work, (3) Multi-tab Socket.IO stock:update live push (open stockkeeper approve harvest in tab A, verify tab B dashboard tile increments without refresh), (4) Laporan tab date filter + Export Excel button downloads a valid xlsx (backend export already verified). Roles verified in UI: marketing (has Produksi read-only visible), produksi (no Surat Jalan), admin (full menu). Login page has data-testid login-username/password/submit.
